info.name: ORVoiceAgent
info.description:
Full workflow examples. The EMR/UI calls only ORVoiceAgent. No auth headers.

JSON bodies already contain a real silent WAV in audio_base64 (not an empty variable).
WAV requests use postman/clip.wav. If Postman still shows Select Files, click it and pick clip.wav in this folder.

Pipeline: voice -> ORScribe transcribe -> DisplayPlugin same path -> that JSON is the response.
Start ORScribe :8030, ORDisplayPlugin :8032, ORVoiceAgent :8035.
